title: Every Flat Map Is Wrong, and You Pick How
summary: Drag one circle around the globe across five projections and watch it stretch, shear or hold its area, with both principal scale factors read straight off the projection's derivatives.

sources.title: Snyder, Map Projections: A Working Manual, USGS Professional Paper 1395 (1987)
Tissot, Memoire sur la representation des surfaces (1881)
Gauss, Disquisitiones generales circa superficies curvas (1827), the Theorema Egregium
